name: lookup_book
description:
Look up a book in the library catalog.

The code argument gives: ISBN-13 of the book, thirteen digits such as 9780306406157. It returns: The catalog record.

name: lookup_product
description:
Look up an item in the store inventory.

The code argument gives: Store SKU in the form AB-1234. It returns: The inventory record.

name: lookup_paper
description:
Look up a published research paper.

The code argument gives: DOI of the paper, starting with '10.', such as 10.1038/nphys1170. It returns: The paper's metadata.

name: cpu_stats
description:
Report processor load for a server.

The host argument gives: Hostname of the server. The window_minutes argument (optional, default 5) gives: Averaging window in minutes: 1, 5 or 15. It returns: Load average over the window.

name: memory_stats
description:
Report RAM consumption for a server.

The host argument gives: Hostname of the server. The include_swap argument (optional, default False) gives: Also report swap / page-file usage. It returns: Used and free memory in MiB.

name: disk_stats
description:
Report storage use for a server.

The host argument gives: Hostname of the server. The mount argument (optional, default '/') gives: Mount point or drive to inspect, such as /var or C:. It returns: Used and free bytes on the mount.

name: send_email
description:
Deliver a written message to a person.

The recipient argument gives: Email address such as name@example.com. The text argument gives: Message body. It returns: Delivery id.

name: send_sms
description:
Deliver a short text message to a person's phone.

The recipient argument gives: Phone number in E.164 form such as +14155550123. The text argument gives: Message body, at most 160 characters. It returns: Delivery id.

name: post_message
description:
Post a message to a team chat space.

The recipient argument gives: Channel name beginning with '#', such as #ops. The text argument gives: Message body. It returns: Message permalink.

name: upload_file
description:
Copy a local file to cloud object storage.

The path argument gives: Local path of the file. The bucket argument gives: Name of the S3 bucket to copy into. It returns: Object URL.

name: attach_file
description:
Attach a file to a support ticket.

The path argument gives: Local path of the file. The ticket_id argument gives: Ticket key such as SUP-1042. It returns: Attachment id.

name: share_file
description:
Create a shareable download link for a file.

The path argument gives: Local path of the file. The expires_hours argument (optional, default 24) gives: Hours until the link stops working. It returns: The link.

name: create_event
description:
Add an entry to the shared calendar.

The title argument gives: Event title shown to attendees. The start argument gives: ISO-8601 start time. The attendees argument (optional, default []) gives: Email addresses to invite. It returns: Event id.

name: set_reminder
description:
Schedule a personal notification.

The text argument gives: What to remind about. The at argument gives: ISO-8601 time at which the notification fires. It returns: Reminder id.

name: block_focus_time
description:
Reserve uninterrupted time on your own schedule.

The start argument gives: ISO-8601 start time. The duration_minutes argument gives: Length of the block in minutes. The mute_notifications argument (optional, default True) gives: Silence all notifications during the block. It returns: Block id.

name: convert_currency
description:
Convert an amount between currencies.

The amount argument gives: Amount to convert. The source argument gives: ISO 4217 code of the source, such as EUR. The target argument gives: ISO 4217 code of the target, such as JPY. It returns: Converted amount.

name: convert_units
description:
Convert a measurement between units.

The amount argument gives: Value to convert. The source argument gives: Unit symbol of the source, such as km, lb or degF. The target argument gives: Unit symbol of the target. It returns: Converted value.

name: convert_timezone
description:
Convert a clock time between time zones.

The amount argument gives: Clock time to convert, such as 14:30. The source argument gives: IANA zone name of the source, such as Europe/Paris. The target argument gives: IANA zone name of the target. It returns: Converted clock time.
